value: **Involvement**: Teachers actively participated in collaborative co-design workshops, design meetings, or teacher communities with researchers to iteratively develop, test, and adapt curriculum units, assessments, and lesson plans. **Evidence**: "In co-design meetings and a teacher professional development (PD) workshop, educators helped refine how Byte Beads could effectively engage students in classroom learning and suggested possible extensions to mathematics, music, and biological concepts."
